product.title: 1975 Rolex Oyster Perpetual Date Green Khanjar for Sultanate of Oman 34mm Stainless Steel 1500
product.description: A rare 1975 Rolex Oyster Perpetual Date in stainless steel with a distinctive green Khanjar dial and automatic movement.

dossier.headline: Green Khanjar Oyster Perpetual Date
dossier.summary: A 1975 Rolex Oyster Perpetual Date reference 1500 in stainless steel, distinguished by a green Khanjar dial bearing the National Emblem of Oman. Made by Rolex with a 34mm steel case and automatic movement, it belongs to the known family of Omani special-order Rolex watches.

facts.label: Dial
facts.value: Green Khanjar, National Emblem of Oman

facts.label: Founded
facts.value: Rolex founded 1905 in London by Hans Wilsdorf

story.title: An Omani Special Order
story.detail: The green Khanjar logo on the dial is the National Emblem of Oman; these Rolexes were made as a special-order variant for the Sultanate of Oman.

story.title: The Reference 1500 Date
story.detail: The ref. 1500 is a vintage Rolex Oyster Perpetual Date, commonly documented as a 34mm stainless steel automatic watch with a smooth bezel and date function.

story.title: Rolex in Geneva
story.detail: Rolex was founded by Hans Wilsdorf in 1905 in London and moved to Geneva, registering Montres Rolex S.A. there in 1920.

references.title: Khanjar Dial Rolex
references.detail: A comparable listing shows a Khanjar dial on a Rolex Oyster Perpetual Date and explicitly ties it to Oman.

references.title: Reference 1500 Calibre
references.detail: Buyer's guides note Cal. 1565/1575 for ref. 1500 production, with a c.1975 example identified with a calibre 1575 automatic movement.
